# gitmoap_repository_branches (Data Source)

List branches in a repository. The repository's branches in name order, each described as reading the branch describes it: tip commit, distance from the default branch, protection, whether you may push, and the open merge requests that propose it. Pages hold up to 100 branches, 20 by default; pass `next_token` back unchanged, and a token this listing did not hand out is refused.

The token needs `branch:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_branches" "api" {
  repo_id = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Optional

- `search` (String) Only the branches whose name holds this, ignoring case

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `ahead` (Number)
- `behind` (Number)
- `branch_name` (String)
- `commit` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--commit))
- `open_merge_requests` (Attributes List) The open merge requests proposing this branch — one per target branch at most. A commit to
the branch updates each of them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--open_merge_requests))
- `protected` (Boolean) A branch rule protects this branch.
- `push_refusal` (String) Why the caller may not push here, in a sentence to show them. Absent when they may.
- `repository_id` (String)
- `viewer_can_push` (Boolean) Whether the caller may push to this branch — the same verdict a `git push` or a commit
written in the browser gets. `false` for someone not signed in.

- `committed_at` (String)

- `committer_name` (String)
- `message` (String)
- `parent_shas` (List of String)
- `repository_id` (String)

- `tags` (List of String)
- `title` (String)
